title: Inside, One Way Only: Subsets Explained Simply | PUC Maths Class 11
description:
Every NEET subject (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) is also a PUC science subject. But Maths is a PUC subject and not a NEET subject. One set sits inside the other, one way only. In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Maths (NCERT Chapter 1, Sets) we learn subsets, proper subsets and equal sets.

You will watch a live element-by-element check prove that NEET is a subset of PUC and fail the other way, see why every set is a subset of itself and why the empty set is a subset of every set, test ALLOY and LOYAL for equality both ways, and nest N, Z, Q and R inside each other. A side-by-side clears up belongs to versus subset, then a pause-and-think question, a worked example with three sets, the exam trap, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11 and JEE Main students.

In this video:
0:00 NEET subjects inside PUC subjects
0:28 What is a subset? A live check
1:06 Two facts: A ⊂ A and φ ⊂ A
1:22 Equal sets: ALLOY and LOYAL
1:53 N ⊂ Z ⊂ Q ⊂ R
2:13 Belongs to vs subset
2:56 Worked example: ⊂ or ⊄
3:33 Exam trap: 1 ⊂ {1, 2, 3}?
3:50 Where it is asked
3:58 Practice question (JEE Main pattern)
4:39 Recap and three questions to answer

Next episode (Ep 6): Power Sets. Three snacks for a tiffin box: how many different ways to pack it, including an empty box?
